build_border_align_layer: build a BorderAlign nn.Module with a given pool_size for border feature pooling on detection boxes
create_border_align_function: create a BorderAlignFunction autograd Function to perform forward and backward border alignment on feature tensors
run_border_align_apply: run the border_align apply function with input features, boxes, and pool_size arguments
review_border_align_forward: review the BorderAlign forward pass that pools features along box borders using bilinear interpolation and max pooling
test_border_align_backward: test the BorderAlign backward pass that computes gradients using saved argmax indices and boxes
